name: Most storage: white BRIMNES storage bed, dresser and BESTÅ column sharing the left wall, bench at the foot
notes:
Alternative, re-designed 2026-10-23: the storage bed, now the most-storage variant. The old b put the dresser on the heater wall and left the left wall empty; here the dresser and the BESTÅ column share the left wall, and the window wall stays clear. 12 placed, 11 extras.
bed-1 BRIMNES white queen storage bed (floor): right wall, headboard centered, rot 90, x 81.75-177, y 35.4-97.6. F-34 and F-32 for its side drawers: 29.4" on the window side to the heater's face, 35.4" on the bathroom side. The drawers' positions along the sides are not on the page: if the head-end drawers reach past the storage headboard, the nightstands may stop them short (unverified).
nightstand-1 VIHALS white (floor): window side of the head, x 162.375-177, y 20.75-35.375. F-33: 14.75" from the heater face. nightstand-2 VIHALS white (floor): bathroom side, x 162.375-177, y 97.625-112.25: slim (14.625" square), so the bathroom door (eyeballed at x 139-169) is approached at full depth across its left 23.375" and has 20.75" in front of its last 6.625" (F-30, F-31). The same white VIHALS line as the dining set.
lamp-1, lamp-2 STORSEGEL (top): on the nightstands. art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide (top): over the 43.75" storage headboard, centered.
rug-1 TIOKRONA (rug): rot 0, x 40-158, y 19.5-113.5: under the lower 76" of the 95" bed and the bench, stopping short of the nightstands; 13.5" off the heater face (F-33).
dresser-1 STORKLINTA 6-drawer (floor): left wall's window end, x 0-18.9, y 12-67.1. F-33: 6" from the heater face (heater-depth-assumed); F-32: 49.9" from its drawer fronts to the bench; anchor-required (F-21). plant-1 FEJKA (top): on its window end.
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 23 5/8x16 1/2x76" (floor, new for F-63): left wall's door end, rot 270, x 0-16.5, y 69-92.6, 1.9" below the dresser. F-31: 10.4" clear of the door's swing (assumed-position:door); F-30: 52.25" to the bench; anchor-required (F-21: 76"). The BRIMNES runs 13" longer than the TARVA, so its foot leaves only 12.75" of the 70" bottom wall free and the column moves to the left wall.
bench-1 PERJOHAN pine (floor): across the foot of the bed, 2" off it, x 68.75-79.75, y 46.8-86.2. F-30: 49.9" to the dresser.
mirror-1 NISSEDAL 25 5/8x59" (top, moved from the extras onto the plan): hung vertically on the walkway stretch of the 70" wall, rot 180, x 103.8-129.4, flat to the wall, so the 35" walkway stays clear: the full-length mirror between the closet and the bathroom.
Walkways (F-30): door to bathroom along the bottom of the room, 35.4" beside the bed; the closet's 24" stays clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet).
Window wall: nothing but the curtains. F-33 allows furniture 6" off the heater, but a cabinet there would box in the heater along the whole hatched wall (heater-depth-assumed), so no BESTÅ goes on it.
Extras: VALEVÅG mattress x1, DVALA queen sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE Full/Queen insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA natural cover set x1, VILDKORN pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window); PURRPINGLA laundry bag x1, kept just inside the walk-in closet (the left wall is full).
Not placed: the TÅGARP floor lamp ikea-70486395 (the left wall is full; the two table lamps light the room, F-41) and the BRIMNES wardrobe ikea-90574800. Same headboard reasoning as a.
Total $2,362.79: placed $1,673.90 + extras $688.89; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed, anchor-required (dresser-1, storage-1).
Design review 2026-10-23: the deeper nightstands covered the right 7 to 10.9" of the bathroom doorway with 14 to 15.4" in front; the slim VIHALS white pair keeps it open (above).
